parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the application group.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for special sources.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The job status.

*   **0**: disables the job.
*   **1**: enables the routing policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 list-work-flows --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace 4a06d5ea-f576-4326-842c-fb14ea043d8d --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id hxm.test --workflow-name Test3 --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --status 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun schedulerx2 ListWorkFlows --region cn-hangzhou --Status 1 --PageNum 1 --PageSize 10 --WorkflowName Test3 --NamespaceSource schedulerx --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace '4a06d5ea-f576-4326-842c-fb14ea043d8d' --GroupId 'hxm.test'
